infoDashboard.title: Please read the following descriptions carefully.

arhatiya.title: Arhatiya (Bahi-Khata)
arhatiya.desc1: An easy way to maintain Arhatiya accounts with interest calculation.
arhatiya.desc2: To start your Bahi-Khata, go to 'Traders' and click the 'Add Industry' button to fill in Arhatiya details.
arhatiya.desc3: After filling the form, go to 'Vendors' to see your shop list. Click the 'FileAdd' icon in the action column to start transactions.
arhatiya.interest_note: In the interest rate field: Enter '24' for 2% interest, '18' for 1.5%, and '12' for 1%.
arhatiya.flexibility: Form fields are designed for different transaction types; fill them according to your needs.

permanent_worker.title: Permanent Worker/Bantaidar
permanent_worker.desc1: For managing records of Bantaidars (workers on 1/4th or 1/5th share).
permanent_worker.desc2: Go to 'Permanent Worker', click 'Add Worker', and fill in their details.
permanent_worker.desc3: Click the 'FileAdd' icon in the worker list to open the transaction form. Follow the guidelines provided on the form.
permanent_worker.advance_note: If advance payment is given with interest, use the same rates as Arhatiya; otherwise, enter '0'.

casual_labor.title: Casual Labor/Daily Wager
casual_labor.desc1: For maintaining accounts of laborers working on an irregular/daily basis.
casual_labor.desc2: Go to 'Casual Labor' and click 'Add Labor' to open the registration form.
casual_labor.desc3: After submitting, click the 'FileAdd' icon in the action column of the table to add transaction details.

machinery.title: Mechanized Hiring/Machinery Rent
machinery.desc1: For managing transactions of Combine harvesters and straw reapers.
machinery.desc2: Go to 'Mechanized Hiring' and click 'New Harvest Entry' to open the form.
machinery.desc3: Enter operator or owner details. After submitting, use the 'FileAdd' button in the list to manage accounts.

info.title: Information
info.tabs: Tabs are available for all transaction types. Use the 'Setting' tab to change language or delete your account.
info.dashboard: All active transactions appear on the Dashboard with category-wise totals and monthly turnover graphs.
info.records: In 'Vendors' and 'Permanent Worker', use the 'Eye' icon to view records and the 'Download' icon to save them.
info.edit_delete: Every transaction can be edited or deleted using the 'Edit' icon in each row.
info.digital_dairy: This is a digital diary (Bahi-Khata) for record-keeping.
info.contact: For any issues or suggestions, contact the developer via WhatsApp or Instagram icons in the footer.
